build_amazon_qa_data: build the Amazon QA dataset by downloading and unpacking all category files into the datapath directory
parse_gzip_file: parse a gzip compressed JSON file and yield each line as a JSON string
download_amazon_qa_resources: download all Amazon QA downloadable files for product categories like Electronics and Automotive
unpack_gzip_to_json: unpack gzip compressed QA data files and write parsed JSON lines to a new file
review_build_function: review the build function that manages downloading, unpacking, and marking Amazon QA data as complete
